tool.name: plasmidfinder_datamanager
tool.command:
#set $database_date, $database_commit = str($database_select).split('_') database_dir='${output_file.extra_files_path}/plasmidfinder-db' && git clone --no-checkout 'https://bitbucket.org/genomicepidemiology/plasmidfinder_db.git' "\${database_dir}" && git -C "\${database_dir}" checkout --detach '$database_commit' &&
for database_file in "\${database_dir}"/*.fsa; do kma index -i "\${database_file}" -o "\${database_file%.fsa}" || exit \$?; done &&
cp '$data_manager_json' dm.json

param.name: database_select
param.label: Database snapshot
param.help: Each snapshot is labelled by date and commithash.

tool.help: Download a PlasmidFinder database snapshot from https://bitbucket.org/genomicepidemiology/plasmidfinder_db/ and build KMA indexes.
